cards.text: Israel is camped at Shittim, ready to cross the Jordan into the land the LORD promised. Joshua, Israel's new leader, secretly sends out two spies. His orders: “Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.”

cards.question: The two spies slip into Jericho and stay at a house there. Whose house is it?

cards.text: Word gets to the king of Jericho: men of Israel came tonight to spy out the land. Day ONE of a secret mission and they're already in the town group chat.

cards.question: The king of Jericho sends a message to Rahab about the spies. What does he tell her to do?

answers.text: Bring the men out to him
Keep the men inside her house
Send the men out of town

cards.question: True or false: Rahab hands the two spies over to the king's men.

cards.text: Rahab had already hidden them. She tells the king's men yes, the men came, but she didn't know where they came from, and they left at dusk right before the gate closed.

cards.question: Rahab tells the king's men she doesn't know which way the spies went. What does she tell them to do?

answers.text: Wait for them at the gate

cards.question: Rahab really took the spies up to her roof. She hid them among the stalks of ___ she had laid out there.

cards.text: The king's men take off after the spies, and the second they're out, the gate shuts. I bet those two are up on that roof holding their breath, like me in the junk drawer every time it rattled open.

cards.question: The king's men chase the spies along the road to the fords of the ___.

cards.text: Before the spies lie down for the night, Rahab climbs up to the roof. And she's got something to say.

cards.question: Up on the roof, Rahab tells the spies something she knows. What is it?

answers.text: The LORD has given Israel the land
The king will find them by morning
Jericho's walls can never be broken

cards.question: True or false: Rahab says everyone who lives in the land is melting in fear of Israel.

cards.text: Then Rahab tells them how it happened: Jericho has heard what the LORD did for Israel. Israel isn't even here yet and the whole town's sweating, like getting a “Quick chat?” text from the boss with NO other details.

cards.question: Rahab says Jericho heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the ___ Sea when Israel came out of Egypt.

cards.text: She names Sihon and Og too, two kings of the Amorites across the Jordan, whom Israel devoted to destruction. When Jericho heard all that, their hearts melted and everyone's courage failed.

cards.question: Then Rahab says something big about the LORD, Israel's God. What does she say He is?

answers.text: God in heaven above and on earth below
God over Israel and no one else
The strongest of all the gods

cards.text: Now Rahab asks the spies to swear by the LORD. She showed them kindness, so she asks them to show kindness back, and she wants a sure sign.

cards.question: Rahab asks the spies to spare lives when Israel comes. Whose?
True or false: The spies agree to show Rahab kindness if she doesn't report their mission.

cards.text: Now the spies need a way out of Jericho. Lucky for them, Rahab's house is built right into the city wall.

cards.question: Rahab's house is built into Jericho's wall. How does she get the spies out?

answers.text: Lets them down by a rope

cards.text: Out the window and down a rope, no stairs, just a WHOLE lot of trust. And before they go, Rahab gives them a plan.

cards.question: The king's men are out on the road to the Jordan. Where does Rahab tell the spies to hide?

answers.text: By the fords of the Jordan

cards.question: Rahab tells the spies to hide there for ___ days until their pursuers have returned.

cards.text: Then the spies set their terms. They won't be bound by the oath unless Rahab does two things when Israel enters the land.

cards.question: First, what does Rahab have to tie in the window she let the spies down through?
True or false: Rahab also has to bring her father and mother and brothers and all her family into her house.

cards.text: And they spell it out: anyone who goes out the door into the street is on their own, but anyone inside with Rahab, the spies take that on themselves. Translation: this is NOT the day to step out and check the mailbox.

cards.question: The spies add one more condition. What would release them from the oath?

cards.text: Rahab doesn't argue. “Let it be as you say,” she replied, and she sent them away.

cards.question: True or false: Rahab waits until Israel arrives to tie the scarlet cord in her window.

cards.text: The spies hide in the hill country for three days while their pursuers search all along the road. I did YEARS in a junk drawer, so three days sounds like a vacation to me.

cards.question: True or false: The pursuers come back without finding the spies.

cards.text: Then the two men come down from the hill country, cross the river and head back to Joshua. They report all that happened to them.

cards.question: What do the spies tell Joshua the LORD has surely done?

answers.text: Delivered the entire land into their hands
Opened the gates of Jericho to them
Sent the king of Jericho running

cards.text: They add that all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of Israel. Sound familiar? Rahab said nearly the same thing up on the roof, and friend, this story is just getting started.
